Package hadur2

Class ShieldTableData

java.lang.Object
hadur2.ShieldTableData
final class ShieldTableData extends Object
Shield part 2 of the 1v1 mode table (docs/plan-shield-quality.md): per opponent, the shield's opening drive (SHIELD-17) and its shipped aim (SHIELD-18); and the opponents the duel surf dodges simple aims against (DODGE-3); and the opponents fought with stop-and-go (POISON-2). Every list starts empty, so Hadur plays as before until a bench run has picked entries for it; moves() and aims() hold shield part 2's (PR #256), stopGos() and stopGoShifts() mode table v2's (PR #263).

moves() and dodges() name opponents, matched by the rule of ShieldListData. aims() holds one "predictor offset name" line an opponent: the predictor (from 0) the shield's records showed best against it, that predictor's offset in radians, then the robot's name as Robocode lists it, with or without its version.

A class, not a resource, for the reason ShieldListData gives: Robocode's sandbox refuses a robot the read of its own jar. Keep the shape: a final class with package-private static methods moves(), aims(), dodges(), stopGos() and stopGoShifts() and dodgePlans(); the bench's smovelist/saimlist/sdodgelist/ sgolist/sgo2list/sdplanlist ablations fill them.
